normalization.p: Every abbreviation the workflow resolved is given as a <choice>: <abbr> is the reading of the RG, <expan> the expansion. Dropping the <expan> of every <choice> yields the text of the RG unchanged; dropping the <abbr> of every <choice> yields the expanded text. An <abbr> outside a <choice> is an abbreviation that was not resolved; it belongs to both readings.
The @resp of an <expan> names the step that decided it.
